id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17d0: "Beyond here is Mount Pang Lai. But General Jasper of Heliodor ordered us to let no one through.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18a0: "Mount Pang Lai is home to wicked folk tied to the Darkspawn. We can't let ordinary people go.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19bc: "You may pass this mountain gate freely. An order to lift the blockade came from Heliodor.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aa4: "Apparently General Jasper, who gave the order, went missing, so there's no need to blockade it anymore.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d3c: "The people living on Mount Pang Lai are deeply tied to the fallen Dundrasil royal family and oppose our Kingdom of Heliodor.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e40: "But opposing Heliodor, said to be Erdrea's strongest, doesn't seem a wise choice.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f54: "...Why do the people on this mountain side so strongly with the Dundrasil royal family?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ff4: "Is there some deep reason to oppose Heliodor? ...Well, none of my business.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20f0: "I was attacked by monsters at the Pang Lai gate, and just when I thought it was over, the village's monks saved me.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21b0: "We Heliodor soldiers were blockading the mountain on Lord Jasper's orders, and they helped us anyway. I'm amazed.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b0: "Lord Jasper told me everyone in this village was a hardened criminal, but they're all good people.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e4c: "Lord Jasper told me everyone in this village was a hardened criminal, but they're all good people.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2368: "Seeing is believing, they say. You can't know the truth without seeing it yourself.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f04: "Seeing is believing, they say. You can't know the truth without seeing it yourself.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2468: "A grand feast welcomed the Luminary who visited this village, I hear. So it was in league with the Darkspawn after all.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2560: "But could such kind villagers really be in league with the Darkspawn...? What on earth should I believe...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26b0: "I always thought the Luminary was a Darkspawn who would destroy the world, but I was wrong.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3020: "I always thought the Luminary was a Darkspawn who would destroy the world, but I was wrong.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2774: "On the contrary, he kept fighting all along to save the world...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30e4: "On the contrary, he kept fighting all along to save the world...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27f8: "Saying so now solves nothing, but let me apologize here. I'm truly sorry.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3168: "Saying so now solves nothing, but let me apologize here. I'm truly sorry.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28fc: "Treated as a villain by everyone, yet fighting for them. Not something an ordinary person could do.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|326c: "Treated as a villain by everyone, yet fighting for them. Not something an ordinary person could do.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29c0: "I respect you from the bottom of my heart. Please do your best to beat the Dark One.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a98: "Fighting for everyone as the Darkspawn, then beating the Dark One. No ordinary person can do that.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b64: "Thank you for saving Erdrea. I respect you from the bottom of my heart.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c34: "An order came from Heliodor to lift the mountain blockade, so I came to look in on this village.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d18: "My country was long hostile to them, so I expected to be turned away at once, but they let me in.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3330: "I respect you from the bottom of my heart. Please do your best to save the world.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|347c: "My hometown is Puerto Valor, southeast. Taught swordplay by notable Sir Diego, I became a Heliodor soldier.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3584: "My little sister is still there, so I'd like to go home to Puerto Valor sometimes. I want to relax with my family.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36ac: "Since the Luminary's Star fell on Gallopolis, unknown monsters have started appearing. We Heliodor soldiers are bewildered.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37ac: "I worry about my hometown Puerto Valor. My sister is still little... I want to go home and reassure my family.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39f0: "This valley leads to an area surrounded by steep mountains called Medalberg.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a9c: "But this deep valley can't be crossed. To reach Medalberg, you'd have to sail to the open sea and find a path.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bf8: "Yggdrasil's fall caused a landslide blocking the road to Puerto Valor, but that's not the only change.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ce8: "On the west Medalberg side, the collapse made it passable. The world's a total mess.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dac: "...Traveler, if you want to go to Puerto Valor, go through the cave along the east beach and climb the hill west.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ed0: "Ah, feels great! Since Yggdrasil revived, the air seems tastier too!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fc4: "Wow, I was surprised. The cliff here collapsed and it's passable now. Such things happen.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4064: "...But it's strange. I feel like I've crossed over here once before when the cliff collapsed...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4140: "...Hmm, strange. I feel like I've crossed over here once before when the cliff collapsed...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42bc: "I crossed the collapsed valley ahead... Being so close to the fallen Yggdrasil, the west side was terribly ruined.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43c8: "And people in eerie outfits have been seen marching in droves. If you go ahead, be very careful.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4500: "Well, how happy. With Yggdrasil revived, the lost greenery will return in time.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4778: "...Fighting together in extreme focus sharpens the heart, and a new talent may awaken to cover one's weakness.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48ac: "Goliath and Hendrik's new power awoke by influencing each other... the strongest weapon, the bond of cooperation.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49ec: "...Listen, if you all work together, you can surely beat even that giant thing swirling black in the sky... I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b4c: "My wife, long gone... once she decided to do something, nothing could move her. She had strong convictions.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c20: "...Goliath will fight that black giant no matter what anyone says. I won't stop him now.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cfc: "...But be careful. That evil aura isn't of this world. Steel yourselves to face it.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e34: "...Oh, I heard, Luminary. You're traveling with Hendrik, right? You must've had a hard time getting here.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4efc: "It's a gloomy town, but take your time and rest.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ff4: "A golden giant is sealed in Kingsbarrow in the Emerald Coast. I'll break the seal, so go beat the giant.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5110: "But winning normally won't do. Goliath and Hendrik, combine your strength and finish it with Grand Ogre Slash. That's the trial.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|51f4: "Grand Ogre Slash is a pep power learned from Hendrik's axe's Ogre Slash and Goliath's one-handed sword's Metal Slash.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|52cc: "Pass the trial and you'll gain the strongest weapon to face any mighty power. Work together and do your best.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|549c: "...Well, since I've gotten into it, leave these odd folks to me. Go beat the Dark One in peace.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5584: "Yes, surely! I'll beat the Dark One and bring bright smiles back to the world!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|564c: "Still all bluster as always! When you beat the Dark One, come back no matter what. I have a ton to say to you.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5784: "Hey, Luminary, how's the journey to defeat the Dark One? It's a big job, but the world's on your shoulders. Hang in there.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5890: "Oh, tell Goliath for me, too. Beat the Dark One quickly, come back to town, and take these folks off my hands.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|59d0: "Hey, Luminary, how's the journey going? In the daytime the folks Goliath brought were so loud. I've finally calmed down.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ad4: "But the folks Goliath brought seem to be trying hard to cheer up the town. I've heard plenty of rumors.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ba0: "Goliath said to look after them, but I feel they look after us more. Only drawback is they're a bit loud.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5cc4: "Huff, huff... Who knew dancing took so much stamina...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5d54: "But Goliath, just you watch! Someday I'll show you dancing so sharp your eyeballs pop out!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5fd0: "I'm sorry. My master is out at the moment and not here. If you like, I can take a message in his place.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|60c8: "Hm, a peddler with a rainbow branch? ...Indeed, a peddler with a strange branch came wanting to buy a villa.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61e0: "...He said he expected a large sum soon and set off for Octagonia.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6280: "Octagonia is far east of here. Land at Champs Sauvages by ship and go further north to reach it.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6558: "Octagonia is far east of here. Land at Champs Sauvages by ship and go further north to reach it.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|63c4: "Traveler, I'm sorry... Sir Diego is out at the moment and not here.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6480: "...The peddler with the glittering branch said he expected a large sum and set off for Octagonia.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6690: "I'll open the sluice gate, so please take your ship by sea to the front of the gate.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6780: "Your ship should be at the pier on the Puerto Valor Coast. Once aboard, circle around to the right.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|685c: "Your ship should be at the pier on the Puerto Valor Coast. Sail south and the sluice gate is right there.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|69e0: "That person I saw then, could it be...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a40: "Oh? You're Lord Rab's friend. Have you gone out to the open sea past the sluice gate?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ae8: "The open sea has the Vanishing Waters. Ships that enter never return, vanishing from this world, they say...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ce8: "The open sea has the Vanishing Waters. Ships that enter never return, vanishing from this world, they say...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bf0: "Please be careful. I pray for your journey's good fortune.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6df0: "Please be careful. I pray for your journey's good fortune.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f24: "Oh, Lord Hendrik! ...I'm glad you're safe. My master will be truly pleased.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fe8: "I'd like you to see my master, but... Sir Diego was badly wounded and is resting in his room.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70cc: "...I'm terribly sorry, but please come again when my master wakes.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|71f0: "You made it safely from war-torn Heliodor. Learning Hero Hendrik is safe will surely please my master.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72e4: "But my master is badly wounded and resting in his room. Please come when he wakes.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7450: "Oh, a visitor. I'm sorry. Sir Diego is badly wounded and sleeping in his room.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7530: "...I'm truly sorry, but for a visit, please come when my master wakes.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7698: "Oh, you're all safe. My master is feeling well today and is awake now.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7770: "My master is in this room, so please do see him. He'll surely be delighted.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|782c: "...But it seems noisy outside. Did something happen?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|78f0: "Seeing Lord Hendrik made my master so happy. I haven't seen him so well in ages.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|79c4: "My master's happiness is my greatest joy. I hope this is a turning point for his health...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b2c: "Ah, young master Goliath... you could rest a little more, but you're leaving again at once.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7bc0: "Cesar... I've put you through so much. I'll definitely beat the Dark One, so until then, support Papa.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ca0: "Of course. When the Dark One is defeated, please come back here. I'll always be young master's butler.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7dc8: "It's been ages since I saw my master so cheerful. My master's happiness is my greatest joy.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ec0: "...Young master Goliath. After beating the Dark One, please come back to this town. I'll always be your butler.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ffc: "Even if his looks and words changed, young master was the same kind-hearted Goliath as then.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|80e8: "I believe young master Goliath and his friends will surely defeat the Dark One. ...Please, everyone, be careful.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8230: "I'm so happy my master has recovered like that. It's thanks to young master Goliath.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8300: "...My master went to the training ground with the troupe. Why not see how they're doing?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8454: "Oh, young master Goliath. I've longed from the bottom of my heart for the day we'd meet again.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|852c: "Though he doesn't show it, my master surely feels as I do. Welcome back, truly.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8614: "...I hear the trial at Kingsbarrow is very difficult. Please be careful.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8728: "Oh, aren't you master Goliath's friend. My master is at the outside training ground watching his students train.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8824: "...Young master Goliath. When your business is done, please come back to this town. I'll always be your butler.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|89f0: "...Young master Goliath. When your business is done, please come back to this town. I'll always be your butler.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|894c: "Oh, aren't you master Goliath's friend. Sir Diego should be somewhere in this mansion.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8bbc: "Sir Diego had a son, but he left town long ago, before I served here, I hear.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8c94: "...Butler Cesar doted on him so much he'd put him in his eye, and still worries about his whereabouts.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d94: "Butler Cesar seems to have something on his mind since opening the sluice gate. He's brooding the whole time. I wonder what.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8ea8: "Since he was badly wounded, my master, bedridden so long, suddenly woke and became well.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8f88: "My master hasn't talked like that in ages. He must be thrilled that his student Lord Hendrik came.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|908c: "My master's son, young master Goliath, returned after a dozen years in a strange form, with many friends too...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9180: "I don't fully grasp it, but Sir Diego is well again, so it's all settled! Surely!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9290: "The woman in this painting was Sir Diego's wife. So beautiful~. She was a star of the Kingdom of Champs Sauvages.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9364: "...But she died young, right after bearing young master Goliath. I'd have loved to meet her once.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|99ac: "...But she died young, right after bearing young master Goliath. I'd have loved to meet her once.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9474: "Oh, young master Goliath's friend. Thank you for beating the Dark One. I've heard from young master Goliath.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|951c: "Oh, since you came, please meet Sir Diego. He'll surely be delighted.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9600: "Oh, did you see Sir Diego's dance? A stern master dancing like that, you must've been surprised.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|96b8: "That razor-sharp dance, you'd never think he'd been laid up with injuries... Amazing. As expected of my master.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|97b4: "Young master Goliath, missing so long, and the hero Lord Hendrik, returning at once. There's no better day!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|98c0: "The painting of a beautiful woman here is Sir Diego's wife... a star of the Kingdom of Champs Sauvages.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9c24: "Bonjour, young traveler! Hmm, a dandy like me can tell! You have a sense of fashion!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a690: "Bonjour, young traveler! Hmm, a dandy like me can tell! You have a sense of fashion!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9cc0: "Right, I'll tell you something good! Among the many armors and accessories, some change your look when equipped!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a72c: "Right, I'll tell you something good! Among the many armors and accessories, some change your look when equipped!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9d98: "But that's not all! Some change your look only when you wear several pieces as a set!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a804: "But that's not all! Some change your look only when you wear several pieces as a set!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9e50: "My book holds some of my secrets! For someone with such tres bien taste, I'll teach this recipe as a token of friendship!

id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a0d4: "Dress a girl in your party in the hat and clothes from that recipe as a set and she'll become a fashionable girl in a flash!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a1a4: "Many fashion items sleep around the world! If you want to be a dandy like me, find them and master the way of fashion!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a470: "Many fashion items sleep around the world! If you want to be a dandy like me, find them and master the way of fashion!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ac10: "Many fashion items sleep around the world! If you want to be a dandy like me, find them and master the way of fashion!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aedc: "Many fashion items sleep around the world! If you want to be a dandy like me, find them and master the way of fashion!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a300: "Bonjour, young traveler! So, are you enjoying fashion?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ad6c: "Bonjour, young traveler! So, are you enjoying fashion?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a370: "...Some armor and accessories change your look when equipped! Sometimes only when worn as a set!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|addc: "...Some armor and accessories change your look when equipped! Sometimes only when worn as a set!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b060: "...Ho ho, traveler. Have you come to see my villa?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b120: "I bought the glittering branch from the Sultan and sold it high in Octagonia, which bought this lovely seaside villa!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b2ec: "The Solcha Canal under this sluice gate bridge connects Puerto Valor, Medalberg, and even the open sea.

tm.「この先は ドゥーランダ山だ。\n だが デルカダールの将軍 ホメロスさまから\: "Beyond here is Mount Pang Lai. But General Jasper of Heliodor ordered us to let no one through.
tm.「ドゥーランダ山は 悪魔の子と\n つながりが深い 悪人たちのすみかだからな。\: "Mount Pang Lai is home to wicked folk tied to the Darkspawn. We can't let ordinary people go.
tm.「この山門は 自由に通っていいぞ。\n 山門の封鎖を解けという命令が\n デルカ: "You may pass this mountain gate freely. An order to lift the blockade came from Heliodor.
tm.「どうやら 命令を出していた\n ホメロス将軍が 行方不明になったらしく\n も: "Apparently General Jasper, who gave the order, went missing, so there's no need to blockade it anymore.
tm.「ドゥーランダ山に住む連中は\n 今はもう滅んだ ユグノア王家と関わりが深く\n: "The people living on Mount Pang Lai are deeply tied to the fallen Dundrasil royal family and oppose our Kingdom of Heliodor.
tm.「しかし ロトゼタシア最強と名高い\n デルカダール王国を 敵に回すとは\n か: "But opposing Heliodor, said to be Erdrea's strongest, doesn't seem a wise choice.
tm.「……この山に住む連中は なぜ そこまでして\n ユグノア王家に 肩入れするので: "...Why do the people on this mountain side so strongly with the Dundrasil royal family?
tm.「わざわざ デルカダールと敵対するとは\n 何か深い理由が あるのか。\n ……: "Is there some deep reason to oppose Heliodor? ...Well, none of my business.
tm.「ドゥーランダの山門で 魔物に襲われ\n もうダメかというところを\n 郷の修行: "I was attacked by monsters at the Pang Lai gate, and just when I thought it was over, the village's monks saved me.
